**Finding submitted — deviation (fallback target).**

- **Existing bargain:** §§ 9.1/9.2 are mirror-image caps (greater of $100,000 or 12 months' charges), § 10 excludes indirect/consequential damages mutually, and indemnification payments sit outside the cap as a separate liability item. Those three fallback elements are already met.
- **Gap:** no carve-out for confidentiality breach, gross negligence or wilful misconduct — aggravated by § 6, which makes Sections 9 and 10 prevail over the AECI for information in the hosting environment.
- **Cure:** one inserted sentence (new 9.3) lifting those three heads out of the 9.1(c)/9.2(c) caps, mutually, leaving all other cap machinery verbatim. The $100,000 floor and the missing data-protection/IP carve-outs are noted in the rationale, not redlined, since the clause otherwise sits at fallback.
